title: Terry Richardson's California Dreamin'
edition: Playboy Special Edition, one-off issue, February 2015

description.main: The one-off Playboy special edition of February 2015, a hundred pages shot entirely by Terry Richardson with four Playmates at landmark California locations including Joshua Tree and the Chateau Marmont.
description.extended:
Terry Richardson's California Dreamin' is the one-off Playboy special edition of February 2015, a hundred pages of the magazine shot entirely by Richardson with four Playmates at landmark California locations.

Playboy announced the issue in July 2014 and ran a six-page preview in its July/August number. The special was first meant for September 2014, was pushed to a Valentine's Day slot, and reached newsstands in late February 2015. The pictures move between Richardson's flash-on-white studio set-ups, thumbs-up included, and outdoor work in the desert at Joshua Tree and at the Chateau Marmont. The front cover is a model in a visor and yellow sunglasses on white; the back cover puts a second model in a cropped California top against open sky. It is a newsstand magazine in format, softcover with no ISBN, with a display date of May 2015.

Richardson, born in New York in 1965 and the son of the fashion photographer Bob Richardson, built his snapshot style in the 1990s pages of Vice, Purple and i-D before Taschen's Terryworld (2004) fixed it in print. The Playboy special appeared while accusations of misconduct from models were already public, and the magazine went ahead with it. The library also holds Terry (Purple Books, 2004) and the James Frey collaboration Wives, Wheels, Weapons.
